headline: Non standard file cols are now matched at light-speed and we get a confidence level for each, for us to decide to prompt the user or not confirmation.

media.alt: Video from the post by Ricardo Velasquez

text:
What took 30+ secs with a Gemini Flash model now takes less than 1 with Jev. 

Non standard file cols are now matched at light-speed and we get a confidence level for each, for us to decide to prompt the user or not confirmation.

TypeSafe AI cooked!

Kudos to @juantrujillodev
